messages:
maria: Need a compact social playbook for the Serving Inference webinar. Outputs: X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn carousel (3 cards), hero 1200x627 PNG, 15s promo MP4, UTMs, and SDR routing doc. Can we lock by EOD tomorrow?
linda: I can run the X + LinkedIn. Plan: announce, stat follow-up, submit-questions CTA, reminder. Two X openers for A/B test (stat-first vs benefit-first).
josh: Draft thread snippets:
1) "We cut inference spend ~40% w/ prefix-caching + batching. Webinar Apr 28 -> [link]"
2) "Live demo + Q&A with infra engineers. Bring traces. Register -> [link]"
3) "We'll share configs & rollout tips. Thread below."
4) "Submit a question and we'll try to answer live: [link]"
priya: UTM convention: utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=serving_inference_launch, utm_content={stat|benefit|reminder}, utm_variant={organic|paid}. Create landing variants /webinar/serving?variant=startup|enterprise.
sam (SDR): HubSpot list = webinar_serving_inference_2026. Routing: round-robin to SDR - Growth. Spike rule: if title contains VP/Director/Head OR company_size>200 -> tag high-intent and notify kevin. Follow-up templates: auto-confirm, high-intent 20m ask, no-show nurture 3 days. I'll paste templates once UTMs/links are final.
alex (Analytics): I'll wire tracking: separate UTMs per audience + GTM events for "submit_question" and "watched_clip". Also will create a dashboard to monitor A/B CTR and landing conversion.
linda: Design asks: hero PNG 1200x627, carousel 3x 1080, 15s MP4 (16:9, <8MB). Need slide title + one-line script. Maria, can you share title?
maria: Title: "Serving LLMs: practical cost-first playbook". Clip script: "Cut LLM inference cost without sacrificing latency. Live Apr 28. Register now."
josh: I'll add two tested CTAs for copy: "Register now" and "Save your seat". We'll A/B on platform. Also prepping LinkedIn carousel copy and 3 pull-quotes.
priya: I'll set the form hidden fields for utm_* and variant. Zap: on submission create HubSpot contact, set campaign tags, add to list, and post a Slack notification to #sales-inbound with a summary.
buffer-bot: Drafts created in Buffer for Apr 26 09:00 (announce), Apr 27 09:00 (reminder). Pending approvals.
alex (Analytics): Suggest we also append utm_test=ab1 for X variant A and ab2 for variant B so we can attribute. I'll add that to the UTM plan.
sam (SDR): Outreach quick templates (placeholders):
- Auto: "Thanks for registering! Calendar invite attached. Want a 20-min check to review your infra goals?"
- High-intent: "Saw your registration and title. We'd love to run a quick cost calc on your traces. Book 20 min -> calendly"
- Engagement follow-up (commenter): "Thanks for the question on X! Can we book 15 to dive into your telemetry?"
linda: I'll prepare two thumbnail options for the clip: stat-first and people-first. Will A/B test. Please upload both to Buffer.
maria: Approval checklist: josh final copy by 3pm, design deliverables by 5pm, priya UTMs + HubSpot by 5pm, alex dashboard by EOD, sam templates by 5pm. Ping this thread when done.
priya: Confirmed. Also adding a field `social_lead_summary` to HubSpot populated by UTM and question text so SDRs get one-line context.
nina: (note: not in participants)
linda: small ask: can we get an on-brand quote from an early customer to include in carousel? Josh, can you pull one?
josh: I'll reach out and try to surface a 1-line quote. If none, i'll use an anonymized stat.
maria: Great. Once assets are in Buffer tag me and i'll approve. Thanks team :rocket:
